key_points: Aksha is an intelligent surveillance system designed for automated monitoring with minimal human intervention.
Utilizes advanced technologies including Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence, and Generative AI for enhanced functionality.
Capable of detecting objects and unusual situations, enabling proactive responses and analysis.
Offers multiple architectural configurations: Aksha on Edge (On Premise), Aksha UI & Backend on Edge, and hybrid models combining Edge & Cloud.
Supports seamless integration with existing infrastructure to enhance operational efficiency.
Designed for scalability and flexibility to adapt to various business needs.
Real-time live recording and processing of video data for immediate insights.
Advanced object detection capabilities including identification of personnel, vehicles, and safety gear compliance.
Customizable alerts allow users to set specific notifications for critical events, enhancing responsiveness.
In collaboration with NDIL, Aksha has been customized for worker safety, integrating Edge + Cloud solutions.
Phased development approach: Phase I focused on foundational capabilities, Phase II enhanced features with Generative AI, and Phase III optimized performance.
Successful implementation on Raspberry Pi 4B demonstrates versatility and cost-effectiveness.
Clients report significant reductions in human monitoring efforts and enhanced detection of abnormal events.
Feedback highlights the value of Aksha in transforming traditional CCTV setups into proactive safety systems.
Continued interest in future updates indicates strong customer satisfaction and trust in Aksha's capabilities.
Effortless scalability through microservices architecture using Kubernetes and Kafka for high message volumes.
Decoupled architecture enhances fault tolerance and maintainability, allowing for independent service updates.
Real-time data processing capabilities ensure timely insights, positioning Aksha as a leader in intelligent surveillance solutions.
